deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve Cardano ecosystem KPIs including monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs: monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue developing KPI tracking from self-reported dashboards toward live on-chain Cardano data.
Use review, debate, temperature checks, final voting, public reporting, and administrator milestone validation before Cardano Builder DAO receives funds.
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury after approved work, governance processes, or funding activities are complete.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with funds first received and administered by an independent council/multisig composed of dRep DAO members before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven funding mechanism for Cardano builders.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, purpose-built, smart contract-governed funding mechanism to support projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs.
The proposal says funded projects will be required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The proposer states that DAO KPI dashboard Version 1 used self-reported KPI tracking and Version 2 moved toward tracking tied directly to live on-chain Cardano data.
The proposer states that the Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
The proposal states that Round 1 funded 20 companies, included 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, distributed 5,541,335 ADA, and achieved 83% governance participation.
The proposal states that Round 2 funded 14 companies, added 18 new members, and achieved 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

The proposer states that official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions.

The administrator council is described as including Cardano Yoda, Marco Grendel Moshi, and one additional unaffiliated active dRep, with funds held separately, auditable by the Cardano community, not delegated to a stake pool, and delegated to abstain voting.

The proposal states that all milestones will be disbursed from an independent multisig governed by assigned dRep DAO members and that CB DAO receives funds only after milestone completion is validated and confirmed by the administrator.
The proposer states that CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after the first two governance rounds and provides an AdaStat transaction link.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue and scale a smart contract-governed funding process for Cardano builders, with KPI tracking, administrator-controlled milestone disbursement, and stated repayment of unused funds.
